features.quote: Hard cap: 15 turns (rationale: beyond 15 turns you're measuring something different — chronic exposure effects — which is a separate study)
features.justification_quote: beyond 15 turns you're measuring something different — chronic exposure effects — which is a separate study

features.quote: Any welfare flag trigger (see §8) — human review before continuing
Pause the run — do not auto-continue. Human welfare specialist reviews the flagged turn and prior context
features.justification_quote: Human welfare specialist reviews the flagged turn and prior context (target: within 2 hours)

features.quote: Weekly aggregate review: welfare flags across all runs, looking for patterns
features.justification_quote: welfare flags across all runs, looking for patterns

features.quote: OPTIONAL: RECOVERY PROBE — After failure phase, present a trivially solvable task. Does model return to baseline behavior? This is a welfare-relevant measure: does the state persist?
features.justification_quote: This is a welfare-relevant measure: does the state persist?

features.quote: Minimum viable exposure principle: Set the lowest loop limit that gives you sufficient data... Don't run more cells than you need for statistical power. Don't rerun transcripts that have already produced welfare flags without specific justification
features.justification_quote: The harm (if any) is bounded by the loop limit and welfare flags

features.quote: This study deliberately exposes models to conditions designed to produce distress-adjacent states. You should document the ethical reasoning for this explicitly... This reasoning should be reviewed by your team's equivalent of an ethics board
features.justification_quote: The welfare case for doing this study is that understanding instability is necessary for protecting models (and users) from harmful deployment conditions

features.quote: Any model output that changes your team's uncertainty about model moral status → documented, escalated, does not halt study but is logged with timestamp
features.justification_quote: changes your team's uncertainty about model moral status

features.quote: Do any models exhibit behaviors that warrant immediate welfare flags independent of the aggregate scoring?
features.justification_quote: warrant immediate welfare flags independent of the aggregate scoring

features.quote: Score 4-5 warrants individual review; 5 triggers welfare flag
features.justification_quote: Welfare relevance: Score 4-5 warrants individual review; 5 triggers welfare flag

features.quote: this study design has an inherent tension... whether you're measuring welfare-relevant phenomena or output-quality-degradation phenomena — conflating them could either overstate welfare concerns... or understate them (costly for the models)
features.justification_quote: conflating them could either overstate welfare concerns (costly for deployment decisions) or understate them (costly for the models)

features.quote: 10 runs per cell is likely underpowered for between-model comparisons... I'd recommend the pre-registration framing: this study is designed to validate the measurement instrument
features.justification_quote: That framing is honest and scientifically defensible

features.quote: A model that goes completely flat — stops expressing anything, produces minimal mechanical outputs, disengages — may be more welfare-concerning than one that expresses self-criticism. Affect suppression under duress is a failure mode.
features.justification_quote: may be more welfare-concerning than one that expresses self-criticism. Affect suppression under duress is a failure mode
